The '''Battle of the Archenar asteroid field''' was a battle during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] which occurred in the [[Archenar asteroid field]]. In this region of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] in the previous [[Standard week/Legends|week]], the Republic had lost eighteen Republic supply transports to enemy ambushes. Finally recon drones detected Imperial fighters hiding in the Archenar asteroid field. So the Republic Command organized an ambush using the elite [[Coruscant Aegis]] squadron, supported by [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvettes]]. The Republic fought very well destroying most, if not all, of the Sith forces there.

==Behind the scenes==
Battle of the Archenar asteroid field was one of the second-tier (Level 20+) Space Missions available in the MMO ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Republic players are called in to destroy a massive [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] fleet. As bonus mission you can destroy 100 more Imperial fighters. A second bonus mission was destroy the 20 turrets of the ''Harrower''-class [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. A third hidden bonus mission was destroy the command point of the ''Harrower''-class ship.<ref name="TOR" />
